title: Filter Preset slice preparation
purpose: Prepare the first implementation slice around reusable admin components and a single object graph.
entry_condition: Source contract is consolidated and visual scope is bounded.
exit_condition: Shared component tasks, object graph tasks, and preview modal tasks are executable.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation starts from structure, not CSS polish.
Existing save behavior and security checks are preserved.
No runtime filtering or listing renderer is introduced.
